001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.json;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory;
004import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonToken;
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
008import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
009import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
010import com.streamConverter.path.JSONPath;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStream;
013import java.io.OutputStream;
014import java.util.ArrayList;
015import java.util.List;
016
017/**
018 * JSON Navigation Command for applying transformations to JSON data
019 *
020 * <p>This command navigates through JSON structures and applies transformations using rules while
021 * preserving the overall JSON structure. It focuses purely on navigation and transformation, not
022 * extraction.
023 *
024 * <p>Responsibilities: - Navigate to specified JSON paths - Apply transformation rules to matching
025 * elements - Preserve JSON structure during transformation - Stream processing for memory
026 * efficiency
027 */
028public class JsonNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
029
030  private final JSONPath jsonPath;
031  private final IRule rule;
032  private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
033
034  /**
035   * Constructor for JSON navigation with typed JSONPath selector and transformation rule.
036   *
037   * @param jsonPath the typed JSONPath to select data
038   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
039   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath or rule is null
040   */
041  public JsonNavigateCommand(JSONPath jsonPath, IRule rule) {
042    if (jsonPath == null) {
043      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot be null");
044    }
045    if (rule == null) {
046      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
047    }
048    this.jsonPath = jsonPath;
049    this.rule = rule;
050    this.objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Factory method for creating a JSON navigation command with typed JSONPath and rule.
055   *
056   * @param jsonPath the typed JSONPath to select data
057   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
058   * @return a JsonNavigateCommand that transforms the specified path with the given rule
059   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
060   */
061  public static JsonNavigateCommand create(JSONPath jsonPath, IRule rule) {
062    return new JsonNavigateCommand(jsonPath, rule);
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  protected String getCommandDetails() {
067    return String.format(
068        "JsonNavigateCommand(jsonPath='%s', rule='%s')",
069        jsonPath.toString(), rule.getClass().getSimpleName());
070  }
071
072  @Override
073  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
074      throws IOException {
075    processJsonWithStreaming(inputStream, outputStream);
076  }
077
078  /** Stream JSON processing with structure preservation */
079  private void processJsonWithStreaming(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
080      throws IOException {
081    JsonFactory jsonFactory = objectMapper.getFactory();
082
083    try (JsonParser parser = jsonFactory.createParser(inputStream);
084        JsonGenerator generator = jsonFactory.createGenerator(outputStream)) {
085
086      // Process with JSONPath filtering - transform matching elements
087      processJsonStreamWithPath(parser, generator);
088
089      generator.flush();
090    } catch (com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParseException e) {
091      handleJsonParseException(outputStream, e);
092    }
093  }
094
095  /** Process JSON with specific JSONPath targeting */
096  private void processJsonStreamWithPath(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator)
097      throws IOException {
098    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
099    JsonToken token;
100
101    while ((token = parser.nextToken()) != null) {
102      switch (token) {
103        case FIELD_NAME:
104          String fieldName = parser.getCurrentName();
105
106          // Reset path for new field at current level
107          if (!currentPath.isEmpty() && currentPath.size() > 1) {
108            // Remove previous sibling field from path
109            currentPath.set(currentPath.size() - 1, fieldName);
110          } else {
111            // Clear and add current field
112            currentPath.clear();
113            currentPath.add(fieldName);
114          }
115
116          generator.writeFieldName(fieldName);
117          break;
118
119        case VALUE_STRING:
120          String originalValue = parser.getText();
121          boolean inTargetPath = isMatchingPath(currentPath);
122          if (inTargetPath) {
123            String transformedValue = rule.apply(originalValue);
124            generator.writeString(transformedValue);
125          } else {
126            generator.writeString(originalValue);
127          }
128          break;
129
130        case START_OBJECT:
131          generator.writeStartObject();
132          // Don't modify path on object start
133          break;
134
135        case END_OBJECT:
136          generator.writeEndObject();
137          // Remove one level from path
138          if (currentPath.size() > 1) {
139            currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
140          }
141          break;
142
143        case START_ARRAY:
144          generator.writeStartArray();
145          break;
146
147        case END_ARRAY:
148          generator.writeEndArray();
149          break;
150
151        default:
152          // Copy all other tokens as-is (numbers, booleans, null)
153          generator.copyCurrentEvent(parser);
154          break;
155      }
156    }
157  }
158
159  /** Simple path matching for streaming JSON processing */
160  private boolean isMatchingPath(List<String> currentPath) {
161    return jsonPath.matches(currentPath);
162  }
163
164  /** Handle JSON parsing exceptions */
165  private void handleJsonParseException(OutputStream outputStream, Exception e) throws IOException {
166    String errorMessage = String.format("JSON parsing error: %s", e.getMessage());
167    outputStream.write(errorMessage.getBytes());
168    outputStream.flush();
169  }
170}
